subject: Post-demo: procurement & billing questions / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-retail.com>, Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acme-retail.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-10T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: procurement & billing questions / next steps

Hi Liam / Sophie —

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps around procurement/billing so we can keep the pilot on track: 

1) Procurement path: you mentioned there may be a formal PO process for purchases > $10k. Can you confirm the threshold and typical timelines?
2) Payment method: is a PO + invoice required, or would you accept credit card for an initial POC?
3) Marketplace: you asked about AWS Marketplace — are you interested in procuring via marketplace if available?
4) Invoice requirements: please confirm the following fields we need to include on invoices: PO number, billing contact, billing address, VAT/tax ID, line-item breakdown, and any required vendor form details.

I've attached a sample invoice format and a draft SOW to show how we present line items. If you can share your vendor form or any required fields (or a template), I can route to our billing ops to pre-populate.

Next steps proposed:
- Liam / Sophie: confirm PO threshold, preferred payment method for POC, and attach vendor form if needed (procurement@acme-retail.com).
- Marissa: confirm Redwood's invoice fields and marketplace availability; loop in billing ops (Neha) and contracts (Dev) for vendor form review.

Attachments: Redwood_Standard_Invoice_Sample.pdf, SOW-Draft.docx

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-retail.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & billing questions / next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from procurement: 

- PO threshold: we require an internal PO for any vendor commitment over $7,500. Typical PO turnaround is 5-10 business days once the vendor form is completed.
- Payment method: for short proof-of-concepts under $5k we can use credit card; anything above that needs a corporate PO.
- Marketplace: yes, we prefer AWS Marketplace purchasing where available to simplify billing and internal approvals. Does Redwood have or plan a Marketplace listing?
- Invoice requirements: we need the following on invoices: our PO number (must appear in the invoice header), our VAT number (we operate in multiple regions), full billing address (see below), and a line-item breakdown. We also need a completed vendor setup form - attaching that now.

Billing address / tax info (for invoices):
Acme Retail Inc.
Accounts Payable
123 Commerce Way
San Francisco, CA 94103
VAT / Tax ID: US-98-7654321

Attaching: ACME_Vendor_Form.pdf (vendor setup form). Please let me know if you need any additional vendor details.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Retail
liam.oconnor@acme-retail.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-retail.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acme-retail.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement & billing questions / next steps

Hi Liam — really helpful, thanks. Quick notes and commitments from our side: 

- PO threshold / card: we can accept credit card up to $5k for a pilot, and we are happy to proceed via PO for anything above that.
- Marketplace: Redwood is in the process of listing on AWS Marketplace; while that finalizes (ETA ~Q4), we can provide traditional invoicing or support procurement via our marketplace reseller if needed. I'll keep you updated on the Marketplace listing progress.
- Invoice fields: we can include PO number in the invoice header, full billing address, VAT/tax ID, and a detailed line-item breakdown. We can also provide a CSV export of line items if your AP system prefers that format.
- Vendor form: thanks for the ACME_Vendor_Form.pdf - looping Neha (billing ops) and Dev (contracts) to confirm any required legal/vendor details. Neha, can you confirm Redwood's vendor setup and whether we need any additional fields for validation?

I've attached Redwood_Tax_Info.pdf with our tax/legal entity information to help your vendor onboarding. Once Procurement confirms the PO timeline and shares the PO number, we can generate an invoice aligned to your requirements.

Proposed mutual action items:
- Acme: complete internal vendor setup and confirm PO timing / whether you'd like to proceed via AWS Marketplace when available.
- Redwood: Neha to validate vendor form fields and confirm invoice template (including CSV option). Dev to review contract & provide any redlines to Sophie / Liam.

Cc-ing internal billing/ops and contracts to accelerate.

Best,
Marissa
Attachments: Redwood_Tax_Info.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: dev.patel@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-11T11:32:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: procurement & billing questions / next steps - action items for billing & contracts

Quick internal note - forwarding the ACME vendor form and their billing details. Action items: 

- Neha: please review ACME_Vendor_Form.pdf and confirm we can populate the requested fields. If we need any supporting docs (W-9 / tax certificate), let me know and I'll request from the customer. Also confirm whether we can produce a CSV invoice export.
- Dev: please review potential contract redlines around payment terms (they requested net30 implicitly with PO turnaround). If we need to propose alternate payment terms, flag asap.

Customer expects PO turnaround ~5-10 business days once vendor form is complete. They prefer AWS Marketplace for procurement where possible - note for our roadmap/priority list.

Thanks -
Marissa
